# Fixture for the post-merge 'invalid_records' integration test.
#
# 'does-not-exist.invalid' can never resolve (RFC 6761). Handed to
# harden-runner as-is, it makes the agent revert and leave the job with
# no egress filtering; filtered out by the action, block mode holds.
api.github.com:443
does-not-exist.invalid:443
